summary: Curry County lookout station from 1919; a cabin dated 1933, a 1937 live-in tower, and the tower destroyed in 1962. No source describes the site today.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com date the first cabin to 1933, and the register's own photo caption reads 'Rocky Peak Lookout 1919 - 1933'. Rex's page records a station on the peak in 1919, a July 1931 item about lumber for a lookout on top, and a 1938 letter about an older house inherited from the state. The story gives the register's dates and says the newspaper items disagree.
The register and firelookout.com give about 3,040 feet. A 1919 newspaper quoted on Rex's page gives 3023 feet. The difference is small and the register figure is used.

notes_for_editor: No source describes the site today, and the story says so. The 1962 destruction rests on the register and firelookout.com; a web search for the storm and this lookout found nothing confirming it, so it is attributed to the register. The 1933 date conflicts with the 1919 and 1931 items and with the register's own 1919 to 1933 photo caption, so the editor may want to review the infobox build year. Access is not stated in any source, so no access key is set. The brief's gone status, Coos FPA agency and elevation are supported.
